title: Machine and Horizon
author: Juniper Amberdale
blurb: Tamsin Lockridge, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
